Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the company's global Technology organization and define the technology strategy, engineering direction, innovation agenda, and long-term technical capabilities.

The CTO will translate business objectives into a scalable technology strategy and work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Security, Finance, and Executive Leadership to build reliable, secure, and high-performing technology platforms.

The role will oversee Software Engineering, Technology Architecture, Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data & Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, IT Operations, Systems Integration, Technology Innovation, and Technology Governance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Vision

Develop and execute the company's long-term technology strategy.

Align technology investments with corporate and business objectives.

Define technology architecture, standards, and strategic priorities.

Evaluate emerging technologies and opportunities for innovation.

Provide technology guidance to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.

2. Engineering Leadership & Product Technology

Lead Software Engineering and technology development organizations.

Establish engineering standards, development processes, and technical best practices.

Partner with Product and Design teams to deliver scalable products and platforms.

Improve software quality, development velocity, and engineering efficiency.

Ensure technology capabilities support evolving business requirements.

3. Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure

Develop scalable enterprise and application architecture.

Oversee cloud infrastructure, networks, systems, and technology platforms.

Establish technology standards for scalability, availability, and performance.

Manage systems integration and enterprise technology dependencies.

Develop long-term infrastructure and capacity planning strategies.

4. Cybersecurity & Technology Risk Management

Establish enterprise cybersecurity strategy and technology controls.

Oversee security architecture, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Identify and mitigate technology, infrastructure, and information-security risks.

Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams on applicable requirements.

Maintain strong standards for data protection, privacy, and system security.

5. Data, Artificial Intelligence & Analytics

Develop the company's data and analytics technology strategy.

Oversee data platforms, data engineering, business intelligence, and reporting.

Evaluate and implement appropriate Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities.

Establish data governance, quality, security, and accessibility standards.

Use technology and analytics to support data-driven business decisions.

6. Technology Operations & Reliability

Oversee IT operations, DevOps, infrastructure, and technology service delivery.

Establish reliability, availability, monitoring, and disaster recovery standards.

Improve system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Develop technology incident and business continuity processes.

Monitor technology performance and continuously improve operational excellence.

7. Innovation & Digital Transformation

Lead technology innovation and digital transformation initiatives.

Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential business applications.

Establish frameworks for technology experimentation and proof-of-concept projects.

Drive automation and modernization of legacy systems and processes.

Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business efficiency through
technology.

8. Technology Organization Leadership

Recruit, mentor, and develop senior technology and engineering leaders.

Build and scale a high-performing global Technology organization.

Establish technology career paths, competency frameworks, and performance standards.

Manage technology budgets, resources, vendors, and strategic partners.

Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, security, collaboration, and continuous
improvement.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Software
Engineering, or a related field.

Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Experience

20+ years of progressive experience in Technology, Engineering, Software Development, or related
functions.

10+ years of senior technology or engineering leadership experience.

Proven experience leading large-scale Technology or Engineering organizations.

Strong experience with enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, software
engineering, and technology operations.

Demonstrated experience leading digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.

Experience managing technology budgets, resources, vendors, and strategic partnerships.

Strong ability to communicate with C-suite executives, senior stakeholders, and Board-level
leadership.

Technology Strategy

Technology Leadership

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.description:
Company Description
Matrixport-NY is a technology-driven organization focused on delivering innovative digital solutions to a global client base. The company emphasizes reliability, security, and scalability in all its platforms and services. Team members collaborate across disciplines to create products that support data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency. Matrixport-NY values integrity, continuous learning, and a culture of experimentation to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving technology landscape. The organization offers a flexible, remote-friendly environment that supports professional growth and cross-functional collaboration.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the overall technology vision, execution, and delivery across Matrixport-NY. This role oversees the design, implementation, and maintenance of technology platforms, ensuring they meet business goals for performance, security, and scalability. Day-to-day responsibilities include guiding IT strategy, supervising technology teams, prioritizing projects, and aligning technical initiatives with organizational objectives. The Vice President of Technology partners with senior leadership to drive strategic planning, evaluate emerging technologies, manage vendor relationships, and optimize resource allocation. This position also ensures strong governance, risk management, and compliance practices within the technology function while fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.
Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, evaluate technology performance, and support informed decision-making.
Deep experience in Information Technology, including infrastructure, applications, cloud services, and security best practices.
Proven ability to define and execute IT Strategy that aligns technology investments with organizational goals.
Demonstrated Project Management capabilities, including leading cross-functional teams, managing timelines, and delivering projects on budget.
Expertise in Strategic Planning, with a track record of building long-term technology roadmaps and transformation initiatives.
Leadership experience in senior technology roles, ideally at the Director or VP level, with responsibility for multi-disciplinary teams.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in fintech, digital assets, or other highly regulated technology sectors is a plus.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

Bonus Points For

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Benefits And Working Environment

Standard office working environment.
Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day per week in the office (unless the employee’s location is outside of NYC or London).
This role may require working remotely full or part time.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
UK-based candidates will need to work at a modified schedule of 12 PM - 8 PM at least 3 days a week.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs

Compensation:
(US Pay Range: $88,277 - $103,222/yr; UK Pay Range: £49,598 - £60,040/yr) Posted pay ranges apply to US-based candidates. Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings

Equal Opportunity Employer:
IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: IT Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

Bonus Points For

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Benefits And Working Environment

Standard office working environment.
Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day per week in the office (unless the employee’s location is outside of NYC or London).
This role may require working remotely full or part time.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
UK-based candidates will need to work at a modified schedule of 12 PM - 8 PM at least 3 days a week.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs

Compensation:
(US Pay Range: $88,277 - $103,222/yr; UK Pay Range: £49,598 - £60,040/yr) Posted pay ranges apply to US-based candidates. Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings
